race.comment: VINNY NAY (4) has the strongest recent line after missing by a long neck at this track last week, despite being bumped at the start, and he also has a direct edge over NON REFLECTIVE and SUPER GOD from that race. It took a good one to beat him last start and the 1650m doesn't look an issue. Can go one better. NON REFLECTIVE (5) was under two lengths from the same winner after making ground from well back and copping interference, while his Northam second the start prior showed he is close to a maiden win. Drawn better now and the rise in trip suits him much better. SUPER GOD (7) finished only just behind that pair last week and had earlier been beaten just under a length at Northam, so he remains a genuine danger with Chris Parnham aboard. ARRESTEDEVELOPMENT (8) brings a different profile, having placed at both starts and found trouble when second at Northam, with his Bunbury debut also suggesting there is more to come. JAKKUSU (12) has claims on debut.
